name: Jeeter | Island Papaya | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Island Papaya brings a wave of tropical flavor with juicy peach and ripe papaya at the forefront. The dry hit leans fruity, opening with bright peach and tropical notes, while the exhale carries subtle earthy undertones to balance the sweetness. Bold, flavorful, and fruit-forward, Island Papaya tastes like sunshine on an island afternoon.
